RaffleForm.title: Solidarity Raffle
RaffleForm.description:
Enter to win a stay at the Living Center Medellín.
Complete your details, select your entries, and good luck!
RaffleForm.ticketsDescription: Every time you buy an entry, your name is added to the wheel. The more entries you buy, the more times your name appears, and the better your chances of winning.
RaffleForm.transferInstructionsLine1: Please make the transfer for {total} to the following account:
RaffleForm.transferInstructionsLine3: Account Holder: Confesión Religiosa Budismo Camino del Diamante
RaffleForm.transferInstructionsLine5: Concept/Reference: Rifa Living Center + Your Name
RaffleForm.transferInstructionsLine6: Once the transfer is complete, save the receipt and upload it below.
RaffleForm.afterPaymentNote: After paying or transferring, return to this page and upload your receipt.
RaffleForm.uploadTitle: Last Step! Upload Your Receipt Here
RaffleForm.uploadDescription: Attach your payment or transfer receipt file (JPG, PNG, PDF - Max 5MB) to complete your entry.
RaffleForm.terms: By participating, you accept the terms and conditions of the raffle.
RaffleForm.redirectToastDescription: A new tab has opened to complete the payment with Bold. Upload your receipt upon returning.
RaffleForm.validationErrorToastDescription: Please correct the fields marked in red before proceeding to payment.

HomePage.pageTitle: Enter to Win a 7-Day Stay at the Living Center Medellin!!!
HomePage.videoUnsupported: Your browser does not support the video tag.
HomePage.introTitle: Help us furnish our new Living Center Medellín and enter to win an incredible stay!
HomePage.introParagraph1: With your valuable participation in this solidarity raffle, we can purchase the dining set for our center. This will be a vital space for sharing meals, teachings, and precious moments with our Sangha.
HomePage.introParagraph2: As a token of our gratitude, we will be raffling a 7-day consecutive stay in our new Living Center Medellín, in a comfortable room with a private bathroom and desk.
HomePage.introParagraph3: We invite you to experience the eternal spring, meditate, and connect with the friends of the local Sangha in this space we are building together.
HomePage.conditionsRaffleDate: The raffle will be held during the end-of-year course, from December 5th to 8th, 2025.
HomePage.conditionsCourseConflict: If the chosen dates coincide with a scheduled course, a private room may not be guaranteed (the best available alternative will be offered).
HomePage.conditionsFood: The stay does not include meals.

SuccessPage.title: Thank You for Participating!
SuccessPage.description:
Your entry has been successfully registered.
You will receive a confirmation email shortly with the details and your receipt.

Good luck in the raffle!
